explanation: Two 20-mass bodies start 1.12 apart and fall toward each other under G=5 with max dt=1/30. By step 2 they close to 0.52 separation with speeds ~8 and ~10.8, so accelerations and velocities change strongly within one outer step. The leapfrog integrator with only 6 substeps cannot resolve this close massive encounter, causing total energy to jump by ~144 (allowed ~108) and violating energy conservation.
